repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == false)
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a periodic `if` check instead of a rising-edge wait. F1 shows motion went true at t=100ms; F2 shows the JoI emitted no action because the `if` condition is only evaluated at the start of the wrapper period (t=0). The IR requires waiting for the rising edge, then executing the body. The candidate must block on the edge rather than sampling it.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed from a periodic `if` guard to a rising-edge state machine: persist a `fired` flag, block until the condition is false if previously fired, block until the condition becomes true, execute the body, and mark fired. This ensures the action fires exactly when the edge occurs.
